posts.title: Hong Kong Bulls become first NBL team to make CBA Club Cup quarterfinals
posts.description: WUHAN, Nov. 22 (Xinhua) -- The Hong Kong Bulls beat the Guangzhou Loong Lions 91-74 on Sunday to become the first team from China's second-tier National Basketball League (NBL) to reach the CBA Club Cup quarterfinals.
